newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Oct 14.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi-Australian committee to examine opportunities for joint investment projects.
- Yamama Cement Company posts a 303 million riyal net profit in the first nine months of 1996.
- Secretary general of the Gulf Cooperation Council hopes Bahrain will attend Gulf Arab leaders' summit in Qatar in December.
Bahrain has said it would boycott the gathering unless Qatar withdraws the case it had taken to the World Court over disputed islands with Bahrain.
- Saudi Arabia's first pesticide plant to start commercial production soon.
